### What do you see instead?

[performance.markResourceTiming](https://nodejs.org/api/all.html#all_perf_hooks_performancemarkresourcetimingtiminginfo-requestedurl-initiatortype-global-cachemode) only takes 5 parameters (timingInfo, requestedUrl, initiatorType, global, and cacheMode) when [the spec](https://w3c.github.io/resource-timing/#dfn-mark-resource-timing) contains those 5 and bodyInfo, status, and deliveryType.

### Additional information

_No response_

review_comments: bodyInfo is currently unused because there's a possible bug where the resource timing is taking fields like encodedBodySize/decodedBodySize from the resource's timing info rather than its resource info.
